system.description:
Summons hostile plants or fungi to serve the caster (roll [[/r 1d10]]):

  • 1–5 (1 HD, [[/r 1d10]]): 1) Blooderfly, 2) Oozie, 3) Vegepygmy.
  • 6–7 (2 HD, [[/r 2d4]]): 1) Phycomid, 2) Fungus Men, 3) Gas Spore Fungus.
  • 8–9 (3 HD, [[/r 1d4]]): 1) Plant-Based Dead, 2) Carnivorous Vines, 3) Fungus Men.
  • 10 (4 HD, [[/r 1d3]]): 1) Shambling Mound, 2) Basidirond, 3) Gibbering Mouther, 4) Carnivorous Vines.
